author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Providence College swept Stonehill in three sets Saturday afternoon during the 21st annual Friar Classic at Alumni Hall. The Friars improved to 7-1, while the Skyhawks fell to 2-8. Providence took the opening set 25-12 and completed the match with a 25-20 win in the third.

The teams were tied 7-7 early in the first set before Providence produced a 15-3 run to build a 21-10 advantage. Tori Otter led the Friars’ attack with 10 kills after recording four kills on five swings in the opening set. Providence also finished with seven team blocks.

Miller McDonald distributed 17 assists, and Ava Dyer led the defense with 15 digs. The victory was Providence’s second sweep of the weekend after a straight-set win over Manhattan in Friday’s home opener. The Friars were scheduled to close the tournament against Holy Cross later Saturday. The early-season results extend a strong start for a team that entered the event after winning all three of its matches at the Ocean State Cup.
dek: Tori Otter delivered 10 kills as the Friars improved to 7-1 during their home tournament at Alumni Hall.
headline: Providence volleyball sweeps Stonehill at Friar Classic
